mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(t.id) AS taskTotalCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(t.id) END AS successRate, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(t.id) END AS failedRate, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.status = 'SUCCESS' AND t.started_at IS NOT NULL AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, t.started_at, t.finished_at) / 1000 ELSE NULL END)), 0) AS averageProcessingTimeMs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.retry_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS retryTaskCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_report ar WHERE ar.status = 'SIGNED'), 0) AS signedReportCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_review rv WHERE rv.status = 'APPROVED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_report rp WHERE rp.result_id = rv.result_id AND rp.status = 'SIGNED' ) ), 0) AS approvedUnsignedCount, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_result r WHERE r.result_type = 'VESSEL_SEGMENTATION'), 0) AS vesselResultCount, COALESCE(( SELECT AVG(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio')) AS DECIMAL(18,8))) FROM analysis_result r WHERE r.result_type = 'VESSEL_SEGMENTATION' AND JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio') IS NOT NULL ), 0) AS averageVesselAreaRatio, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_result r WHERE r.result_type = 'VESSEL_SEGMENTATION' AND JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio') IS NOT NULL AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio')) AS DECIMAL(18,8)) < 0.01 ), 0) AS abnormalLowVesselRatioCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_result r WHERE r.result_type = 'VESSEL_SEGMENTATION' AND JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio') IS NOT NULL AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio')) AS DECIMAL(18,8)) > 0.30 ), 0) AS abnormalHighVesselRatioCount FROM analysis_task t
SELECT COALESCE(quality_status, 'NOT_CHECKED') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM image_file WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(quality_status, 'NOT_CHECKED')
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM analysis_review GROUP BY status

SELECT COALESCE(r.model_name, 'UNKNOWN') AS modelName, COALESCE(r.model_version, 'UNKNOWN') AS modelVersion, COALESCE(r.result_type, t.task_type) AS resultType, COUNT(r.id) AS resultCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(t.id) END AS successRate, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.status = 'SUCCESS' AND t.started_at IS NOT NULL AND t.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, t.started_at, t.finished_at) / 1000 ELSE NULL END)), 0) AS averageProcessingTimeMs, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN r.result_type = 'VESSEL_SEGMENTATION' AND JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio') IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio')) AS DECIMAL(18,8)) ELSE NULL END), 0) AS averageVesselAreaRatio, CASE WHEN COUNT(rv.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN rv.status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(rv.id) END AS reviewApprovedRate, CASE WHEN COUNT(rv.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN rv.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(rv.id) END AS reviewNeedsChangeRate, CASE WHEN COUNT(t.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(t.id) END AS failedRate FROM analysis_result r JOIN analysis_task t ON t.id = r.task_id LEFT JOIN analysis_review rv ON rv.result_id = r.id GROUP BY COALESCE(r.model_name, 'UNKNOWN'), COALESCE(r.model_version, 'UNKNOWN'), COALESCE(r.result_type, t.task_type) ORDER BY resultCount DESC, modelName, modelVersion

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'CRITICAL' AS level, '图像质量 FAIL/ERROR 但仍执行血管分割' AS reason, t.id AS taskId, t.task_no AS taskNo, r.id AS resultId, t.case_id AS caseId, t.task_type AS taskType, t.status AS status, COALESCE(t.finished_at, t.updated_at, t.submitted_at) AS createdAt FROM analysis_task t JOIN image_file i ON i.id = t.image_file_id LEFT JOIN analysis_result r ON r.task_id = t.id WHERE t.task_type = 'VESSEL_SEGMENTATION' AND i.quality_status IN ('FAIL', 'ERROR')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WARNING' AS level, CASE WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio') IS NULL THEN '血管面积比例缺失' WHEN CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio')) AS DECIMAL(18,8)) < 0.01 THEN '血管面积比例异常偏低' ELSE '血管面积比例异常偏高' END AS reason, t.id AS taskId, t.task_no AS taskNo, r.id AS resultId, t.case_id AS caseId, t.task_type AS taskType, t.status AS status, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM analysis_result r JOIN analysis_task t ON t.id = r.task_id WHERE r.result_type = 'VESSEL_SEGMENTATION' AND ( JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio') IS NULL OR CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio')) AS DECIMAL(18,8)) < 0.01 OR CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.result_json, '$.vesselAreaRatio')) AS DECIMAL(18,8)) > 0.30 )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CRITICAL' AS level, CONCAT('医生审核结果：', rv.status) AS reason, t.id AS taskId, t.task_no AS taskNo, r.id AS resultId, t.case_id AS caseId, t.task_type AS taskType, t.status AS status, rv.reviewed_at AS createdAt FROM analysis_review rv JOIN analysis_result r ON r.id = rv.result_id JOIN analysis_task t ON t.id = r.task_id WHERE rv.status IN ('CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'REJECTED')
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 'CRITICAL' ELSE 'WARNING' END AS level, CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN '任务最终失败' ELSE '任务多次重试后成功或处理中' END AS reason, t.id AS taskId, t.task_no AS taskNo, r.id AS resultId, t.case_id AS caseId, t.task_type AS taskType, t.status AS status, COALESCE(t.finished_at, t.updated_at, t.submitted_at) AS createdAt FROM analysis_task t LEFT JOIN analysis_result r ON r.task_id = t.id WHERE t.status = 'FAILED' OR t.retry_count > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'INFO' AS level, '已审核通过但尚未签发 PDF' AS reason, t.id AS taskId, t.task_no AS taskNo, r.id AS resultId, t.case_id AS caseId, t.task_type AS taskType, t.status AS status, rv.reviewed_at AS createdAt FROM analysis_review rv JOIN analysis_result r ON r.id = rv.result_id JOIN analysis_task t ON t.id = r.task_id WHERE rv.status = 'APPROVED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_report rp WHERE rp.result_id = rv.result_id AND rp.status = 'SIGNED' ) ) alerts ORDER BY createdAt DESC LIMIT 100
